events.details: Crazy Broadband ADSL retail ("The Craze in Internet Connectivity", with customer login); crazy.com.au was a parked Netregistry BizCard in 2004-05, with the branded retail site captured 2006-07.

ABR lists ABN 83 402 157 060 as BARKER, ROBERT MICHAEL (QLD individual/sole trader, cancelled 21 Sep 2016), which does not corroborate the "Comcen-backed" description; the ABN attribution is unverified.
